html:
G'oya

Haydovchi hodisa qatorida ikki ustunning istalganida turishi mumkin, va ball qaysi ustunda turganiga bog'liq. Masalani soddalashtirish uchun har bir hodisani ikki qatorga yoyamiz: driver_a uchun bitta va driver_b uchun bitta, har biri o'z balli bilan. Keyin haydovchilarga LEFT JOIN qilib, ballarni yig'amiz.

Yechim

SELECT d.name AS driver, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS points
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT driver_a AS driver_id,
         CASE guilty WHEN 'a' THEN 3 WHEN 'ikkalasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM accidents
  UNION ALL
  SELECT driver_b,
         CASE guilty WHEN 'b' THEN 3 WHEN 'ikkalasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM accidents
) p ON p.driver_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name

guilty NULL bo'lsa, CASE dagi hech bir WHEN mos kelmaydi va ELSE 0 ishlaydi. Namunada Aziz 1-hodisada aybdor (3) va 2-hodisada sherik (1), jami 4. Sardor hodisaga tushmagan va 0 bilan chiqadi.

Tuzoqlar

UNION ALL o'rniga UNION. UNION bir xil qatorlarni bitta qiladi, va bir haydovchining ikki hodisasidan bir xil ball kelsa, bittasi yo'qoladi. Sardor ikki hodisada aybdor bo'lsa, ikkalasidan ham (Sardor, 3) qatori chiqadi va natijada 6 o'rniga 3 qoladi:

Noto'g'riSELECT d.name AS driver, COALESCE(SUM(p.points), 0) AS points
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT driver_a AS driver_id,
         CASE guilty WHEN 'a' THEN 3 WHEN 'ikkalasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points
  FROM accidents
  UNION
  SELECT driver_b,
         CASE guilty WHEN 'b' THEN 3 WHEN 'ikkalasi' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  FROM accidents
) p ON p.driver_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.id, d.name

Ballni "ikkinchisi aybdor bo'lmasa, men aybdorman" deb yozish (CASE WHEN guilty = 'b' THEN 0 ... ELSE 3). Tergovdagi hodisada guilty NULL, va ikkala haydovchi ham 3 olib qo'yadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Hodisalarni ikki ustunning istalgani bo'yicha ulash ham mumkin: ON a.driver_a = d.id OR a.driver_b = d.id. Unda CASE ichida haydovchi qaysi tomonda turganini tekshirish kerak bo'ladi. Natija to'g'ri chiqadi, lekin OR li shartda indeks ishlamaydi va katta jadvalda baza har bir haydovchi uchun hamma hodisalarni ko'rib chiqadi. Tezlik testidan o'tmaydi.
